newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar extends gains after recent sales.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar extends gains after recent sales.

text.p: White sugar futures continued their bounce higher after the recent sharp declines as trade players covered short positions but the closeness of nearby values reduced switch activity, market sources said on Thursday. "At the moment we're seeing some short covering and a bit of producer and trade buying," said one trader, adding that the strength had been balanced by limited speculator selling.
At 1609 GMT most traded positions had gained ground, with December up $3.20 at $331.50 and March up $1.80 at $331.20.
Traders said there was little fundamental news to spur the London market, despite Tunisia's recent spate of snap tenders.
Trading was relatively quiet in Paris where just 177 lots were on the board. December was up $2.90 at $331.60 and March up $1.80 at $331.50.
